prompt: 3 days in Lisbon: what to see and eat

plan.title: 3 Days in Lisbon: What to See and Eat
plan.description: A fast guide to spending three days in Lisbon, from hilltop viewpoints and old tram streets to pastries and fresh seafood. Learn what to see and eat each day.

beats.narration: Lisbon is a city of seven hills, and three days is enough to fall for it. Start with the old streets, yellow trams and sunlit viewpoints.
Day one, wander the old neighborhoods on foot. Climb to a viewpoint at sunset, and stop for a custard tart with coffee.
Day two, head to the riverside. See the historic monuments by the water, then eat grilled fish and fresh seafood for lunch.
Day three, take it slow. Browse a market, hear live music in the evening, and end with a late dinner. Lisbon rewards the unhurried.
